body.x: DeepScent, will work with the Daejeon Information CultureIndustry Promotion Agency, for 4 days from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri),in "MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT '(BOOTH # 52843) at CES 2019EUREKA PARK, the world's largest technology exhibition, held in Las Vegas, USA,and showcase the smart fragrance box' Arom '.

DeepScent is developing a smart fragrance box 'Arom' that combines IoT technology and fragrance to consume fragrances in new ways. Smart fragrance box 'Arom' can change the aroma according to taste and provides a fragrance solution that adds sensitivity to space with the smell that suits your situation. After putting four fragrance capsules in the Arom box, you can DIY the fragrance through the IoT-based app linked to the internet.

"We are developing a B2B product that can be applied to domestic and overseas hotels," said DeepScent. "We want to expand our new fragrance solution through consumer experience." "We will recommend the fragrance through user data, and plan to expand and apply it to various businesses."

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third eveningof the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held.In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated byAVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company.
